title: Retail Sales Performance Report: 2023–2024
executive_summary: Across 520 cleaned orders, the business generated $445,325 in total revenue over 2023–2024, with a healthy 10.1% year-over-year increase. The East region led all regions in revenue. Within 2024, revenue accelerated through Q3 before a modest Q4 dip. High-discount Electronics orders represent a notable revenue concentration risk, and a single top customer accounts for 6.2% of total revenue.

key_findings.statement: The business recorded 520 orders totalling $445,325 in revenue, yielding an average order value of $856.39.
The East region generated the highest revenue at $130,517, followed by North ($124,846), West ($99,428), and South ($90,534). East outpaced South by approximately $40,000.
Within 2024, revenue grew strongly from Q1 ($36,108) through Q3 ($71,675) before declining slightly in Q4 ($68,949). Q2 contributed $56,617. Q3 was the peak quarter, nearly double Q1.
Total revenue grew from $211,976 in 2023 to $233,349 in 2024, a year-over-year increase of 10.1%, indicating solid business momentum.
There were 22 Electronics orders with a discount of 20% or more, generating $50,035 in combined revenue. These high-discount orders warrant margin scrutiny given their scale.

Order revenue is highly right-skewed: the mean is $856.39 but the median is only $313.28, with a standard deviation of $1,295.74. Orders range from $5.27 to $7,844.02, indicating a long tail of high-value transactions.
The dataset contains 222 distinct customers. The single highest-revenue customer contributed $27,793, representing 6.2% of total revenue—a meaningful concentration for one account.

limitations: The analysis covers only the cleaned subset of the raw export; any orders removed during cleaning are excluded and may affect representativeness.
Discount percentage thresholds for the high-discount Electronics filter are applied as-is; the profitability or margin impact of those discounts is not assessed.
Customer concentration is measured by revenue share only; order frequency and product mix per customer are not analysed.
The 2024 quarterly trend covers only orders present in the dataset and may be incomplete if the export was pulled before year-end.
Regional assignments are taken from the cleaned data without validation against geographic master data, so misclassified orders could distort regional comparisons.
conclusion: The business delivered $445,325 in revenue across 520 orders in 2023–2024, with a 10.1% year-over-year uplift. The East region leads geographically, and 2024 showed strong mid-year momentum peaking in Q3. The wide spread between mean and median order values highlights a skewed revenue distribution driven by a small number of large orders. Management should monitor high-discount Electronics activity for margin erosion and assess dependency on the top customer, who alone accounts for 6.2% of total revenue.
